# xiaozhi-esp32-server-golang

> ESP32 智能终端 AI 语音后端，端到端全流式 ASR → LLM → TTS，支持 WebSocket / MQTT-UDP 多协议接入与管理控制台。

## Docs

- [HOW_TO_USE](docs/dev/HOW_TO_USE.md)
- [PROJECT_MAP](docs/PROJECT_MAP.md)
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md)
- [README](README.md)

## Stack

Go 1.24 主服务 + Gin 管理后端 + Vue 前端

## Entry

- Main: `cmd/server/main.go` (`./xiaozhi_server -c config/config.yaml`)
- Manager API: `manager/backend/main.go`
- Manager UI: `manager/frontend/`

## Commands

- Build: `go build -o xiaozhi_server ./cmd/server/`
- Test: `go test ./...`
- Governance check: `powershell -File scripts/check-governance.ps1`

## Key Modules

- Transport: `internal/app/server/websocket/`, `internal/app/server/mqtt_udp/`
- Chat pipeline: `internal/app/server/chat/`
- Providers: `internal/domain/{vad,asr,llm,tts,mcp,rag}/`
- Admin API: `manager/backend/router/router.go`
